hook.name: AgroLastro PoolAGL
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the AGL/USDC pool that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the hook itself, locking all liquidity permanently. After each swap, it updates a transient quota (EIP-1153) tracking AGL net flow to gate token transfers in/out of the PoolManager. Collects a fixed 2% LP fee withdrawable only to a designated fee recipient.
